name: build-slice
context_rationale: build-slice requires interactive plan-mode approval gates, mid-slice smoke-gate user halts, and continuous milestone.json updates during execution — all of which depend on the live conversation thread.
summary: Executes the current slice end-to-end using plan mode plus a sequence of verification gates. The Builder enters plan mode to explore code with code-review-graph queries and targeted Reads, drafts a task sequence, and obtains explicit user approval before writing code. Execution proceeds task-by-task with per-task verification, a mandatory mid-slice smoke gate, and a multi-audit pre-finish gate before declaring the slice done. Outputs build-log.json and hands off to /code-review.

reads.purpose: Primary input: acceptance criteria, must-not-defer list, test-first flag, verification plan.
Design spec read during prerequisite check and plan mode.
Critic findings read to check for BLOCKED status and enforce constraints.
Checked for presence by CRP-1 prerequisite and pre-finish audits.
Read by state_transition_pin_audit (STP-1) to compare live risk statuses against pinned test values.
Project build rules read by BC-1 and checked for canonical integrity by BCI-1.
Referenced for SVW-1 shippability context at pre-finish.
CRP-1 and DCE-1 audit tools read triage.json frontmatter mode field.
AVFS-1 and TVFS-1 gates read in-repo VERSION.
Code graph consumed by code-review-graph queries during plan mode.
Allowlist of cross-chunk seam targets passed to mock_budget_lint.

outputs.purpose: Continuously updated during build to record stage, task progress, current focus, next-action.
Flight recorder written during execution and finalized with summary, plan, gates, deferrals, files changed.
DCE-1 requires /drift-check full-mode to append a Trigger entry referencing the slice.

tools.name: wt_root_audit
tools.purpose: WT-ROOT-1 enforcement (Step 6 pre-finish): asserts slice code lives in the worktree $wt and the main tree is clean (no edits leaked out of $wt). Shared with /validate-slice.

tools.name: critique_review_prerequisite_audit
tools.purpose: CRP-1 gate: verifies critique-review.md is present before build entry and again at pre-finish.

tools.name: _worktree_paths
tools.purpose: Computes canonical worktree path and branch name from the single shared source.

tools.name: drift_check_audit
tools.purpose: DCE-1 gate: verifies /drift-check full-mode appended a slice-referencing trigger line to drift-log.md.

tools.name: branch_workflow_audit
tools.purpose: BRANCH-1 gate: verifies commits live on the correct slice/NNN branch.

tools.name: utf8_stdout_audit
tools.purpose: UTF8-STDOUT-1 gate: verifies every tools/*.py main() reconfigures stdout to UTF-8.

tools.name: pipeline_chain_audit
tools.purpose: PCA-1 gate: verifies every covered pipeline skill carries a well-formed Pipeline position block.

tools.name: build_checks_integrity
tools.purpose: BCI-1 gate: asserts live build-checks.md files match git-tracked canonical fixtures.

tools.name: state_transition_pin_audit
tools.purpose: STP-1 gate: detects stale test pins referencing old skill prose or outdated risk-register status values.

tools.name: new_agent_warning_audit
tools.purpose: NAW-1 gate: warns if any agents/*.md were added in this slice's diff.

tools.name: test_first_audit
tools.purpose: TF-1 gate: verifies every AC maps to a PASSING test when Test-first is declared.

tools.name: build_checks_audit
tools.purpose: BC-1 gate: reads build-checks.md, filters applicable rules, refuses if any Critical rule unacknowledged under --strict.

tools.name: wiring_matrix_audit
tools.purpose: WIRE-1 gate: verifies design.md includes a wiring matrix with consumer entry point and test for every new module.

tools.name: mock_budget_lint
tools.purpose: LINT-MOCK gate: lints test files for mock-budget violations, escalating cross-chunk-seam targets to Critical.

tools.name: skill_vault_write_safety_audit
tools.purpose: SVW-1 gate: verifies every SKILL.md directive mutating a shared-aggregate vault file routes through vault_edit append.

tools.name: code-review-graph
tools.purpose: Code graph via code-review-graph (CRG) — reachability / blast-radius / keyword+semantic search via CRG MCP tools. Replaces graphify; vault-graph & multimodal-ingest uses dropped.
tools.note: External pip package (github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph), MCP-native; graph stored in .code-review-graph/. Replaces graphify.

harness_tools.name: Read
harness_tools.purpose: Load mission-brief.json, design.json, critique.json, ADRs, and source files during plan mode.

harness_tools.name: Glob
harness_tools.purpose: Discover file paths during plan-mode exploration.

harness_tools.name: Grep
harness_tools.purpose: Search for symbols and integration points during plan mode.

harness_tools.name: Edit
harness_tools.purpose: Modify existing source and configuration files during task execution.

harness_tools.name: Write
harness_tools.purpose: Create new source files and write build-log.json.

harness_tools.name: Bash
harness_tools.purpose: Run build/test commands, git operations, smoke-gate checks, and all pre-finish audit tool invocations.

missing_references.reason: External pip package, intentionally not bundled in the plugin.
